statement: theorem nonzero_energy_zero_prefix_canary : let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 1 then 3 else if t = 3 then 4 else 0 let Q : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ := fun v n => ∑ t ∈ range n, ‖v t‖ ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), ‖v i‖ ^ 2) let S : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ := fun v n => ∑ i ∈ range n, ‖v i‖ ^ 2 (2 : ℝ) / 2 * Q g 4 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (S g 4) ∧ Q g 4 = 31 / 5 ∧ S g 4 = 25 ∧ Q g 4 < 2 * Real.sqrt (S g 4) ∧ g 0 = 0 ∧ g 2 = 0 ∧ g 1 = 3 ∧ g 3 = 4
